name: Forager's crop
description: A forager's pouch with its mouth rolled open and three finds riding up out of it. The hide is dyed with earth — a rust base under a warmer lit face pushed up-left, so the shaded side is the base showing rather than a shadow laid over it — hand-stitched along the lower seam in ochre dashes, and drawn shut by a timber cord whose knot and two ends hang down the right. A pale tanned bag was the first read and it was a sack from anywhere; the dye, the seam and the cord are what make it a thing somebody in this world made. The rolled rim is drawn last so the three finds sit in the pouch rather than on it, and they are stones cut as hexagons at three sizes and three tilts, two husk and one bone, so they read as three things and not one thing repeated. The count is the ability, so they are counted rather than suggested. They were gold for a pass and had to be pulled: $gold is this game's currency — ss.pickup.coin and ss.icon.greed are both a gold disc — so a bag of it says jelly, which is the one relic on the shelf this must not be mistaken for. They were pale spheres with a bright speck before that and read as three eyes; faceting them is what made them objects. The body is two values and not three: three even offsets turned it into concentric ellipses, which at this size is a target. Nothing on the plate is a hole — the far wall inside the open mouth is a lit husk tone and not the panel, since a dark ellipse above a bright body is a mouth at this size, and the vertical creases a full bag gathers were drawn and cut because two dark lines under a round body are legs. Two open containers already sit on this shelf and both stay clear: ss.relic.doubleyolk is the same trick — domes above a rim — but a cracked white eggshell holding two orange yolks, and ss.relic.tithe is a shallow dish of red with nothing standing out of it. Deep $rust is otherwise only an accent in this library, so a body this size in it belongs to nothing else on the shelf.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
